purpose: Allow translation-only constrained assemblies to opt into deterministic intra-component collision isolation during the preserved donor-core collision stage without rewriting the donor solver or silently overwriting caller collision-group semantics.

properties.constraints: constraint-composer translation mounts and/or distance joints
properties.options: optional isolation enabled flag plus nested composer options

relationships.basis: The donor core remains byte-for-byte untouched; isolation is expressed by a temporary caller-side collision-group projection around the donor collision step.

limitations: isolation applies to whole connected constraint components rather than direct constraint edges only
components containing any nonzero caller collision.group are skipped rather than overridden
only translation mounts and center-to-center distance joints are understood
no angular inertia, rotating local anchors, hinge, slider, rotational weld, motor or gear semantics
core contact evidence describes the temporary-group collision stage before caller groups are restored
persistent_state: none; temporary collision groups are derived per step and caller groups are restored before returning

proves: overlapping constrained bodies can be excluded from donor-core contacts when isolation is eligible
caller collision groups are restored on the final world
existing nonzero caller group semantics cause an explicit skip rather than silent override
temporary negative groups are allocated deterministically while avoiding ids already present in the world

truth.basis: The capability names its component-wide behavior, exposes skipped components and preserves the exact donor collision-stage world used for contact evidence.

agency.basis: Isolation is explicit and caller-controlled, and existing nonzero collision-group choices are not overwritten.

continuity.basis: It composes around the existing mixed-constraint lane and preserved donor source rather than replacing either.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The first collision-suppression step is deliberately bounded to deterministic connected components and declines ambiguous existing group semantics instead of guessing.
